steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Haha! Ahahaha!

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Well done, well done! But, now what? What will this accomplish? Now, all of us are doomed to die here together!
Ela ignores the man who lies collapsed on the ground and howls like a beast in the throes of death as she swiftly walks over the edge of the balcony.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: We're going to bend the rules a bit for the next part. I'll grab one of the hostages and rappel through the windows below, and I need a volunteer from us to do the same.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Well, shoot. Forgot to bring the stuff with us when we left Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Seriously?!

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Calm down, I was just cracking a joke. But, there's a better way.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: What better way?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Put this on. It's a multi-functional jet-gliding backpack we had Closure make for us back at Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Looks like one of those life vests you can get on airplanes.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: That was the inspiration for its design, but as for what it does, thanks to Closure, it not only expands into a glider for distance, but also has a jetpack functionality for landing.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: And you're sure this thing works?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: How else would we have been able to get inside this building from the sixth floor?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: In any case, put it on, give the handle on the bottom a good pull, leave the top one alone, and it'll get you safely to the ground. This one's yours, Ela.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Thanks for the help.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Mr. Diaz, this one's for you.
The old firefighter neatly straps the backpack on himself.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: And as for Mr. Reynell here...
Blitz shoots Ela a questioning glance, but Ela simply shrugs her shoulders.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I promised someone that I'd save this guy's life, if I had the chance.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Then, this one's for you.
Reynell catches the backpack but simply stares at it without putting it on.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Sir, I think you should put it quickly. I like jokes as much as the next guy, but it's best not to joke around too much with your life on the line.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Perfect. I recall that Ela over there said not too long ago she couldn't protect a man who plays jokes with his life.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Back then, I said that she had the wrong idea, since I still had work to do.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: But now... My work is all finished, so...

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Does it really matter if I joke around with my life?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Just put the damned thing on and stop being an idiot.
Reynell shrugs as well before putting the backpack on.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Follow my lead. Everyone who hasn't used one before, pay close attention.
Reynell retreats two steps, watching Blitz plummet from the edge of the balcony, wobbling around in midair as he flutters his way down.
Next up is Diaz. The tall man with the accent somewhat similar to Fuze's pats him on the shoulder before helping him pull the handle.
The people on the balcony leave one by one, until only Reynell and Ela remain.
Reynell still seems to be hesitant, so Ela activates both of their jetpacks before pulling Reynell to leap off the balcony.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Wait, Reynell, what are you doing?!

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: As I said, what's wrong with joking around with my life?
Reynell takes off the backpack and goes into freefall.
Ela's shout resounds in his ears and she seems to grab onto his leg for a moment, but gravity quickly pulls him into its embrace.
Reynell does not know whether it is the swimming pool or cold concrete that will greet him at the end of his trip, but this time, he has no safety rope or backpack.

He tries to taste the difference between his weightlessness in this moment and bungee jumping, whether or not he is trembling, and whether this trembling is commensurate with the destruction he has wrought—
But before he can form any conclusions, he feels a round object squeeze its way into his hand, followed by a blunt pain in his back.

Forced to open his eyes against the strong wind, Reynell vaguely catches a flash of Originium Arts, simultaneously feeling a number of small, hard balls pressing against his body in a struggle against gravity.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: ...Golf balls?
He does not know if he was suddenly gripped by an urge to survive, or if the golf balls are exacting one last insult upon him, but whatever the case, Reynell accepts it.
The golf ball in his hand emits a similar light, drawing an increasing number of other golf balls in the vicinity towards his back like magnets, slowing his fall.
Reynell, after plunging into the swimming pool, bobs up and down a few times in the water before finally floating to the surface—
More precisely, a mat of densely packed golf balls is floating atop the water's surface, with Reynell lying on his back atop it.
He stands up steadily from the floating golf ball mat, even hopping back onto dry land in a single step.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Miłosz, Miłosz! Where are you? I know you're here!

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Ela, where's Miłosz?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: No idea, haven't heard from him—

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Stand still. Where do you think you're going?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: I need to find Miłosz. I need to get to the bottom of this.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: You think you can just walk away?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: What are you going to do, arrest me?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Nobody here has that authority, but you should at least give an explanation to the people swept up in this situation.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Swept up?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: I never intended for any of you people to be 'swept up' in the first place. This was meant to be an artwork of destruction, harming nobody but the investors who deserve it.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Mateo, drunk off his ambitions, and Diaz, who can't mind his own business...

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Oh, and of course, you. Your people were responsible for bringing us, step-by-step, to the situation we are in now.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: What does that make you then? An honorable rebel? An artist?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Why, both, of course.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I'll give it to you, you certainly are a rebel. But there's not an honorable cell in your body. You're rotten to the core.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: What was that stunt you pulled on the balcony? Throwing away your only shot at being rescued was your idea of rebelling?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: What do you think death is? A way to show how world-weary you are? Is it cool to tiptoe around the brink of death?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Making me, Miłosz, and all the other people who still care whether you live or die worry. Is that your idea of rebellion?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: You're grasping at straws just to give yourself a way to vent your frustrations—

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Sure, of course you'd disagree. You think it's all a bit of good, dumb fun that doesn't matter in the end, and wasting other people's investment money was your real form of rebellion.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Ah yes, won't someone think of the investors' money? You must have a fantastic solution that doesn't involve anyone getting hurt—

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Don't you know, nobody will see your explosions as any lamentation of art? All they'll see is a raving lunatic.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: You've got your father's inheritance money. You've got dozens of ways to express yourself, to satirize, to rebel. But you've chosen the laziest option, the one least likely to ever reach any hearts.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: That's simply their inability to understand–

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: What's the point of your so-called art and rebellion if nobody can understand it?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: You hate your father, sure, but have you actually thought through how to really rebel against him? Or are empty gestures of rebellion enough for you?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Hah, who even cares at this point? Probably only you.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: ...You're awful.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: As if that's news to you?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Oh no, I always knew you were...

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: An awful jackass, through and through.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: You're allowed to care about nothing, that's your prerogative. But Miłosz cares! He went so far as to tell me what happened to your mother, just to get me to help you!

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Miłosz?!

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: He told me that your mother was a true artist, and that you used to take after her when you were younger！

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Used to...?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: What else? Do you think you resemble her in the slightest now?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: A man who loves art would destroy the works of countless masters just to show how much of a rebel he is?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Art can be for truth, for good, for beauty, for fighting evil, or just for art's sake. Doesn't matter. It means something different to everyone.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: But, if making your so-called art means burning everyone else's work, and maybe even their lives... Isn't that just pure evil?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: A round of explosions, a landscape of wreckage, a lump of chaos. Is that the 'art' you say you're dedicating to everyone?!

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Ask yourself: what would your mother have thought of all this? Would she be proud of what you've done?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Seriously, Reynell...

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Grow up already.
Ela throws a punch, and it lands squarely in Reynell's face.
Reynell's whole body wobbles, and he falls straight back into the swimming pool.
Ela steps away from the side of the pool, but Reynell still feels the gaze of another pair of eyes.
A blurry figure seems to be standing on the other side of the pool, looking at him from afar. He cannot discern if the look on that man's face is one of concern or sadness.
The morning sun is dazzling, and he can't see clearly. But, he feels with certainty that the gaze resembles his mother's.
He turns his eyes toward the sky, no longer looking at that figure.
The man lingers for a moment, before leaving quietly, wearing a sorrowful expression.
Perhaps, he never would be the son who makes his mother proud. Perhaps, that man would not be willing to remain at his side.
In the end, he is still alone.
When he thinks on this, all the paranoia and grievance that had tormented him all this time suddenly seem insignificant.
He left in the end. In this moment, that is the only thought on Reynell's mind.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Everything inside taken care of?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: The Dossoles police sure took their sweet time. But they rushed over very quickly the moment they heard the danger had passed.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Especially when they say 'just leave the rest to us.' Really makes them seem like the most reliable force in the world.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Hah.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: What about the blocked stairwell? Did they clean that up too?

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: They have some people who specialize in Originium Arts for that purpose. Feels a bit like cheating.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Heh. You'll get used to it soon enough.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: I'm curious though, how did you come to show up at that exact time, precisely on the floor above the blockage point?

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: The timing was pure coincidence. As for why we managed to thread the needle location-wise... Tequila sent a message to the Mayor at the same time he reached out to us.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: When we arrived at the Mayor's office, she was already observing the scene live from multiple angles, both inside and out.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Wait, she had eyes on the inside among the hostages?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: More or less. She told us a frontal assault wouldn't work, then generously gave us the green-light to jump in from Dossoles's tallest building.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: In fact, we wanted to drop in right on the balcony to give that captain a good scare, but didn't have the altitude to make it. Gotta work with what you have.

The assembled crew turns to look at the balcony on the top floor of the art gallery. The fires have already been extinguished, and all that remains visible is the Captain's limp arm, dangling precariously in the air.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Looks like the guy's luck ran out.
Before Doc can finish speaking, the arm suddenly springs to life, fingers curling as they claw at the air, seemingly being dragged away by something.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: I take it back. He didn't fall off the edge, didn't die in the conflagration, and even managed to get saved by the police in the end. The guy's got the devil's luck.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Ela, the Dossoles PD want you to take Reynell over. I think they want to give you a special thank-you letter and put you on TV or something.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I have to be seen on TV... with Reynell? Forget it.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Yeah, that's what Ernesto said too.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: He also said, don't get too cozy with the government here unless you plan on settling down in Dossoles. If you catch Ms. Candela's eye, things are only gonna get extra tricky for you.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Well, have them take Reynell away themselves.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: That works. They don't seem like they have much else on their hands right now anyway.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Alright, let's head out and take a look around. This city might be all about the glitz and glamor, but it's not without its flashes of real brilliance.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: It's not bad. When you stop by Rhodes Island to resupply, we'll show you around.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Speaking of Rhodes Island... Doc, when you visit, I'll need you to put on a few extra pieces of clothes, plus a hood.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Then I'll take you to HR to ask for a bigger budget for our team, and you just nod along with whatever I say. Act natural, especially when I call you by your name.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Huh?
The people who had arrived on Terra previously, as well as Catapult, were stunned for a few moments before all breaking out in laughter.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: See, there's this Rhodes Islander who–

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: C'mon now, Cohen, where's the fun in spilling the beans this early?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: (*smiles wryly*) Fair enough.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: In any case, it's great seeing all of you again.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: It really makes me realize... just how long it's been.
The sky is clear, and a gentle breeze blows in from the artificial sea. Though the draft is hot and humid, it is somehow also quite refreshing.
A warm, friendly din comes from Galería Krysztauowa behind her.

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: Where am I...?

steps.name: Destitute Noble
steps.text: You're finally awake.

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: What are you doing in my house?! Oh, wait, this isn't my house, it's...

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: Shit! G-Give me a hand! We need to evacuate everyone! There are bombs in the building!

steps.name: Destitute Noble
steps.text: You've been out cold this entire time. Both the Capitán and Reynell have been arrested, the bombs have been defused, and it's time to celebrate.

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: Huh?!
Other dazed locals also began sitting up, one by one, looking around in confusion.
The exhibition hall has become a lively carnival for artists.
Most conspicuous of all is the center of the hall, now converted into a dance floor where people are romping and reveling.
And all around the dance floor without borders, graffiti on self-extending canvas, sprawling cables laid out for rock 'n roll, popcorn movie reels...
Even the food carts are available to all. Artists, hostages, and even the police officers who are here to handle the case stop by.

steps.name: Community Artist
steps.text: Broooo, you've gotta try this extra-deep dish demon pepper pizza, fresh out of the oven! They aren't even charging for it!

steps.name: Community Artist
steps.text: Don't just stand there all stone-faced – this food's so good it's gonna make you cry! ...Hey, I'm doing you a favor here and you're still giving me that stink eye. What, you from Siracusa or something?

steps.name: Dossoles Police Officer
steps.text: What does being Siracusan or not have to do with anything? I just realized, you're the little shit who spraypainted my police car!

steps.name: Community Artist
steps.text: Huh... Now that you mention it...

steps.name: Community Artist
steps.text: Meh, what's the big deal anyway? Here, try a bite of this pizza first!

steps.name: Dossoles Police Officer
steps.text: Hmph. If you didn't do a good job getting everyone evacuated, I would drag you down to the station.
The police officer takes a big bite of the pizza, and remarkably, a streak of tears actually flows down his cheeks.

steps.name: Dossoles Police Officer
steps.text: It's just the pure spice that makes you cry, isn't it?!

steps.name: Newbie Investor
steps.text: Where are you flying, tired fowlbeast♪

steps.name: Newbie Investor
steps.text: Towards tomorrow's wind♪

steps.name: Community Hawker
steps.text: I thought you were just another greedy jerk, but it turns out, you can rock out after a couple glasses of wine, huh?

steps.name: Newbie Investor
steps.text: What are you on about...? I was the lead singer in my alma mater's rock band! If only the folks back home didn't put so much pressure on me... You think I like nodding along and kissing ass?

steps.name: Newbie Investor
steps.text: The old fart's not around, right? Lemme tell you straight-up, that guy loves surprise inspections more than anything else, peeking at what you're doing on your terminal. If you're not working, he takes it straight out of your salary!

steps.name: Newbie Investor
steps.text: Last time, I shut off my terminal just as he was coming by. He got mad and started demanding that I turn it back on. But lo and behold, it was nothing but pages and pages of work! He was so mad, he tried to kick my chair! Hah!

steps.name: Seasoned Investor
steps.text: The hell did you just say?!

steps.name: Newbie Investor
steps.text: Huh? You tell me. That's the whole truth right there.

steps.name: Newbie Investor
steps.text: Here you go, boss!
The drunk man pops open a bottle of beer with his ear, an act that wins him raucous applause, and pours it all over the livid old man.

steps.name: Excited Tourist
steps.text: We really struck the jackpot this time! We not only got to see Reynell's announcement, but also visited the Galería, and now we even got to participate in a pop-up street artist festival!

steps.name: Excited Tourist
steps.text: (*whispers*) This is probably a bit of an exaggeration, but we might not have had the same luck without Mateo–

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Are you serious, amigo?

steps.name: Excited Tourist
steps.text: N-N-No, of course not! I was just making an off-handed remark!

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: We're all adults here, so watch what you say.

steps.name: Excited Tourist
steps.text: G-Got it! Let's head over to the dance floor!

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Papá, why are you sitting over here instead of joining in the celebrations?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Because I'm getting old, and already had my share of excitement this morning. Wouldn't want to get in the way of the youths.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: I'll go do my own thing then?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Go ahead. Have a good time with the others.
Tecno shrugs and heads towards the dancefloor, her small frame quickly disappearing into the crowd.
The old firefighter squints his inebriated eyes, involuntarily tapping along to the rhythm of the music as he watches the never-ending parade of people on the dance floor.
That is, until a man approaches him from the other end of the exhibition hall, exuding an aura completely incongruous with the gaiety and joyousness of the event.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Hey, Diaz. Congratulations, you got to hold your party at my place after all.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Got a problem with that?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: I'm not so stingy. Plus, I'm not going to let a little provocation get to me.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Sounds nice. Wanna take the dance floor for a song or two?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: ...I'll pass.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Oh, your 'dance partner' isn't here. He doesn't seem to want to dance with you anymore.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Nonsense.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: What about you, then? Why are you out here drinking by yourself? Where's your dance partner?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: You're asking the wrong guy.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: If I wanted to dance, I'd have my pick of anyone in this hall right now. Anyone, except for you.
